sources.title: Land affected by contamination
sources.verified_claim: Government planning guidance explains that contamination can harm health and environment and can limit development, and that planning must ensure land is suitable for its proposed use; national guidance does not establish contamination at a sample parcel.

sources.title: Pollution
sources.verified_claim: Enfield states it inspects contaminated land where significant risk exists and maintains a contaminated-land register/search service; borough records are not treated as a match to parcel_30762 without exact spatial or property evidence.

sources.title: Contaminated land
sources.verified_claim: Havering states it considers contamination in planning, may require developers to investigate and remediate higher-risk land, and maintains a Part 2A public register; these controls do not establish parcel_46142 contamination.

sources.title: Land quality reports
sources.verified_claim: Havering offers property-specific land-quality reports using geology, hydrology, historical land use, landfill and pollution records; the existence of this search route is evidence of verification methodology, not a result for the sample parcel.

sources.title: Contaminated land
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth describes contaminated-land inspection and property-search routes where significant harm may affect health, water or ecosystems; no parcel_61522 contamination result is inferred without an exact search.

sources.title: Registers - Brownfield Land Register
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's Brownfield Land Register lists previously developed sites meeting suitability, availability and achievability criteria and states it has no Part 2 sites; inclusion in Part 1 is not a clean-land certificate or full planning permission.

sources.title: Brownfield Land Register
sources.verified_claim: Havering's Brownfield Land Register identifies previously developed sites assessed for housing-led development and distinguishes Part 1 from optional Permission in Principle Part 2; register status does not prove absence of contamination or technical consent.

sources.title: Brownfield Land Register
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's Brownfield Land Register records previously developed sites meeting statutory criteria and states it has no Part 2; Part 1 status is not a contamination clearance or full permission for a sample parcel.
